newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Golden Tiger in Vietnam coal review.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Golden Tiger in Vietnam coal review.

text.p: Golden Tiger Resources NL said on Thursday it had signed an agreement to review Vietnam's coal and peat industries, select viable projects and arrange appropriate financing.
Golden Tiger managing director Rupert Crowe said in a statement the company had signed a letter of understanding with Vinacoal, the Vietnam National Coal Corporation.
Crowe said the coal review process was to start immediately with a specialist consultant arriving in Hanoi within the week. "This new direction is very good news for Golden Tiger," he said.
"Increasing its power supply capacity to fuel growth is one of the main priorities for the Vietnamese economy and the government is looking to the coal industry to fill the gap," he said.
Golden Tiger intended to pursue the new coal initiatives in parallel with its ongoing base and precious metals exploration projects and its Na Tum manganese pre-feasibility studies, he said.
